scripts.review: bash -o pipefail -c 'test -n "$SST_STAGE" && test "$SST_STAGE" != "production" && diff_file=$(mktemp) && trap '"'"'rm -f "$diff_file"'"'"' EXIT && sst diff --stage "$SST_STAGE" > "$diff_file" && cat "$diff_file" >&2 && sha256sum "$diff_file" | cut -d " " -f 1'
scripts.deploy: bash -o pipefail -c 'test "$SST_DEPLOY_APPROVAL" = "DEPLOY" && test -n "$SST_STAGE" && test "$SST_STAGE" != "production" && test "$SST_APPROVED_STAGE" = "$SST_STAGE" && test -n "$SST_APPROVED_MONTHLY_COST_USD" && test -n "$SST_APPROVED_DIFF_SHA256" && pnpm run validate && diff_file=$(mktemp) && trap '"'"'rm -f "$diff_file"'"'"' EXIT && sst diff --stage "$SST_STAGE" > "$diff_file" && cat "$diff_file" >&2 && current_diff_sha256=$(sha256sum "$diff_file" | cut -d " " -f 1) && test "$SST_APPROVED_DIFF_SHA256" = "$current_diff_sha256" && sst deploy --stage "$SST_STAGE"'
